useful_glyph_ideas: Alpha: generous inner space and short restrained right exit.
Beta: unequal bowls, open inner spaces and controlled waist.
Theta: open oval interior and clear horizontal crossbar.
Upsilon: rounded basin and continuous curve distinct from sharper nu silhouette.
Xi: compact three-stage serpentine movement with clear intervening white.
Omega: broad paired bowls and balanced central join.
Phi: restrained oval balanced against clear straight stem.
Bold rows suggest preserving counter area and managing joins deliberately.
